created_after_pipeline_construction_note: This precommitment file was authored after eleven phases of the offline historical replay lane had already been implemented and tested. It is a retrospective/final-gate precommitment for the first end-to-end Family 1 verdict run, not a clean pre-registration before all empirical work began. Future lanes should pre-register their precommitment before any pipeline construction.

data_config.date_availability_note: Verified via public API on 2026-05-18. Kraken Trades API with since=1738540800 returns data starting at 2025-02-03T00:00:00.080Z. Pagination via the 'last' field continues through the day. Full-day coverage: approximately 15,000 trades per hour during active hours.
data_config.resolution_note: Kraken public Trades API returns time-and-sales trade data at second-or-better granularity. No OHLCVT/bar data will be used for this verdict run. The pipeline must use one of the trade-level resolution types (RESOLUTION_TRADE or RESOLUTION_AGG_TRADE) for all Family 1 hypotheses.

fdr_config.alpha_note: Fixed at 0.05 before the run. Do not tune after seeing p-values.
fdr_config.method_note: Benjamini-Yekutieli (BY) for conservative dependency-aware correction. Hard-coded: do not switch to BH mid-run after seeing p-values.

horizon_eligibility.horizons_invalid_if_bar_data_only: If only OHLCVT/bar data is available, sub-minute horizons requiring tick resolution are invalid. The verdict run must not decide data resolution mid-flight.
horizon_eligibility.horizons_valid_for_trade_resolution: All horizons supported. Trade-level data provides sub-second event resolution, so any Family 1 horizon (from milliseconds to minutes) is valid. No sub-bar tick-style horizons are excluded — trade data natively supports all.
horizon_eligibility.resolution_pinned_note: The data-resolution decision is pinned to trade/tick before any verdict run consumes this file. No runtime discovery of available granularity will alter this decision. If the pipeline encounters only OHLCVT/bar data during Phase 1 prepare, it must reject with UNSUPPORTED_RESOLUTION_FOR_FAST_HORIZON or equivalent diagnostic — it cannot fall back to bar data mid-flight.

signal_definition.timestamp_matching_rule: first tick at or after requested timestamp
signal_definition.missing_tick_rule: explicit exclusion, no interpolation, no fabrication
signal_definition.sign_convention: positive means BTC/USDT became more expensive versus BTC/USD
signal_definition.direction_mapping: basis_change_bps < 0 → long (expect USDT recovery toward USD); basis_change_bps > 0 → short (expect USDT reversion toward USD)
signal_definition.forward_return_evaluation: direction_sign * target_return_bps, unscaled by signal magnitude
signal_definition.minimum_lookback_rationale: Kraken XBTUSDT observed ~700 trades/hour (~5s between prints). Sub-30s lookbacks produce weakly observed basis-change measurements and are excluded for Kraken trade-history data.
signal_definition.lookback_inertness_fix_note: This precommitment replaces the old instantaneous-basis evaluator which never read cell.lookback_ms. All Family 1 cells now compute basis_change_bps over the lookback window.
